theme: System with toggle. Light Theme for ERP Dashboard (maximize data readability). Dark Theme available, especially for Marketing pages to convey premium positioning.

rules: No Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings.
Headlines > 32px MUST use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter.
Overlines/Labels MUST be Uppercase, text-xs, tracking-[0.2em].
Use tabular-nums class for all data grids, tables, and KPIs.
Tinted Grey Rule: Neutral greys must have a tiny blue/orange tint.
Color is Function Only: 95% of dashboard UI monochrome.
Never use full-screen gradients. Texture over Gloss.

surfaces: Crystal Glass (Marketing Sticky Headers): bg-white/70 (Light) / bg-black/60 (Dark) + backdrop-blur-xl + backdrop-saturate-150 + 1px delicate inner stroke.
Dashboard Cards: Flat solid background, 1px subtle border (border-border), no shadow. Hover: -translate-y-1, shadow-sm.
Grid Borders: Expose the skeleton for feature grids using border-collapse layouts.

marketing.classes: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 lg:gap-12
marketing.rules: Asymmetry. Never fill 100% perfectly. Leave breathing room.

dashboard.classes: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6
dashboard.rules: Every pixel utilized. Use h-full on children. Top-left priority for KPIs.

layouts.marketing_page: High visual impact. Overlapping elements, bento grids, aggressive asymmetry. Heavy negative space.
layouts.dashboard_platform_admin: Collapsible left sidebar navigation. Modular cards/widgets. Progressive disclosure. Dense tables.
layouts.dashboard_school_admin: Same as platform admin. Use visually distinct 'Coming Soon' cards for future ERP modules (Students, Attendance, etc.).
layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more spacing (p-8, p-12). Containers with border MUST have padding (p-6/p-8) to avoid collision.

motion.marketing: High. Parallax, scroll-triggered effects, micro-interactions using Framer Motion.
rules: Use specific transitions, NEVER transition: all.

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for text below 18px. Use APCA.
accessibility.focus: Focus states must have HIGHER contrast.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (kebab-case, role-based).

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use framer-motion for UI transitions. No 3D libraries needed for this phase.

instructions_to_main_agent.tech_stack: JavaScript/JSX (.js or .jsx). DO NOT use TypeScript (.tsx).
instructions_to_main_agent.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react for both dense dashboards and marketing.
instructions_to_main_agent.shadcn_overrides: Override Shadcn tablist h-9 with h-auto to prevent content cutoff. Never use native inputs/selects; always use Shadcn Form, Input, Select.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid 'AI slop'. Make creative, distinctive frontends.
Dark colors look good when used independently. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use grid/bento layouts as defined.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where instructed.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is FORBIDDEN).
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Prioritize using pre-existing Shadcn components. Do not build complex interactive components from scratch.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or surfaces that have content under them.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
